source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 30 (PDF 202-216), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 30 (Spectroscopy-2 NMR) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 In chemistry, NMR spectroscopy is particularly used for:
(Chemistry mein NMR spectroscopy khaas taur par kis kaam aati hai?)

options.text: organic compounds ki pehchaan aur un ki structure maloom karna

blocks.explanation: Chemistry mein NMR khaas taur par organic compounds ki pehchaan aur un ki structure maloom karne ke liye istemal hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: this technique is particularly used for the identification of organic compounds

blocks.prompt:
2 The two most commonly used NMR methods for organic compounds are:
(Organic compounds ke liye sab se zyada istemal hone wale do NMR methods kaun se hain?)
blocks.explanation: Proton (¹H) NMR aur carbon-13 (¹³C) NMR do sab se aam methods hain.

book_ref.quote: Proton (¹H) NMR and carbon-13 (¹³C) NMR are two most commonly used methods

blocks.prompt:
3 Which of the following is NOT listed in the chapter as a field where NMR is used?
(In mein se kaun sa field chapter mein NMR ke istemal ki jagah ke taur par NAHI likha gaya?)

options.text: proteins aur natural products ka mutaala

blocks.explanation: NMR chemistry, polymer industry, proteins aur natural products ke mutaale, environment monitoring aur medical field mein istemal hoti hai; smelting ka zikr nahi.

book_ref.quote: polymer industry, study of proteins and natural products, environment monitoring, and medical field

blocks.prompt:
4 NMR spectroscopy is based on which property of nuclei?
(NMR spectroscopy nuclei ki kis khoobi par mabni hai?)
blocks.explanation: NMR spectroscopy nuclei ki magnetic properties (nuclear spin) par mabni hai (30.1).

book_ref.quote: NMR spectroscopy is based on the magnetic properties (nuclear spin) of nuclei

blocks.prompt:
5 Which atoms usually show signals in NMR?
(Kaun se atoms aam taur par NMR mein signal dete hain?)

options.text: even mass aur even atomic number wale atoms

blocks.explanation: Odd mass number wale atoms, jaise ¹H aur ¹³C, aam taur par NMR signal dete hain; un ke nuclei chhote magnets ki tarah hote hain.

book_ref.quote: Atoms with odd mass numbers usually show signals on NMR

blocks.prompt:
6 In the absence of a magnetic field, the nuclei of a sample:
(Magnetic field na ho to sample ke nuclei:)

options.text: sab aik doosre ke saath aligned hote hain
do mukhtalif energy states mein hote hain
be-tarteeb rukh mein hote hain aur energy aik jaisi hoti hai
sab high energy state mein hote hain

blocks.explanation: Magnetic field ke baghair tamam nuclei be-tarteeb (random) rukh mein hote hain aur un ki energy aik jaisi hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: In the absence of a magnetic field, all the nuclei have random orientation

blocks.prompt:
7 When placed in a strong magnetic field, nuclei such as ¹H give rise to:
(Taqatwar magnetic field mein rakhne par ¹H jaise nuclei kya paida karte hain?)

options.text: do spin states, aik low energy aur aik high energy
barabar energy ki teen spin states

blocks.explanation: Taqatwar field mein nuclei field ke saath ya us ke khilaf align hote hain, yun do spin states bante hain: low energy aur high energy.

book_ref.quote: these nuclei align themselves either with or against the field

blocks.prompt:
8 The radiation used to flip nuclei from the low to the high energy state in NMR is:
(NMR mein nuclei ko low se high energy state mein flip karne ke liye kaun si radiation istemal hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Radio waves dalne se low energy state ke nuclei energy jazb kar ke high state mein chale jate hain (spin flipping).

book_ref.quote: By irradiating with radio waves, the nuclei at low energy state can absorb energy

blocks.prompt:
9 The movement of a nucleus from the low energy spin state to the high energy spin state is called:
(Nucleus ka low energy spin state se high energy spin state mein jana kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Radio wave ki energy jazb kar ke nucleus ka high state mein jana spin flipping kehlata hai.

book_ref.quote: and move to higher energy state (spin flipping)

blocks.prompt:
10 An NMR spectrum is obtained from the energy that nuclei:
(NMR spectrum us energy se banta hai jo nuclei:)

options.text: solvent ko heat ki shakal mein dete hain
khud magnet se jazb karte hain
ionise ho kar X-rays ki shakal mein kharij karte hain
apni asal states mein wapas aate waqt kharij karte hain

blocks.explanation: Flip hue nuclei jab apni asal states mein wapas aate hain to energy kharij karte hain, jo detect ho kar NMR spectrum ban jati hai.

book_ref.quote: they emit energy which is detected and converted into an NMR spectrum

blocks.prompt:
11 The position of a nucleus in a compound together with its surrounding atoms is collectively called the:
(Compound mein nucleus ki jagah aur us ke ird gird ke atoms ko mil kar kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Nucleus ko flip karne ki exact energy us ki jagah aur ird gird ke atoms par munhasir hai; inhein mil kar molecular environment kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: collectively known as the molecular environment

blocks.prompt:
12 In methanol (CH₃OH), the methyl and hydroxyl hydrogens absorb different frequencies of radio waves because they:
(Methanol (CH₃OH) mein methyl aur hydroxyl hydrogens mukhtalif frequencies kyun jazb karte hain?)

options.text: un ke mass numbers mukhtalif hain

blocks.explanation: -CH₃ hydrogens (carbon par) aur O-H hydrogen (oxygen par) mukhtalif environments mein hain, is liye mukhtalif energy jazb karte hain.

book_ref.quote: three hydrogen atoms are attached to a carbon atom and one hydrogen atom is bonded to an oxygen atom

blocks.prompt:
13 Nuclei in different environments can be flipped with radio waves of the same frequency if:
(Mukhtalif environments ke nuclei ko aik hi frequency ki radio waves se kab flip kiya ja sakta hai?)

options.text: magnetic field ki taqat badli jaye
solvent ko paani se badla jaye
magnetic field band kar diya jaye

blocks.explanation: Agar magnetic field ki taqat badli jaye to mukhtalif environments ke nuclei aik hi frequency ki radio waves se flip ho sakte hain.

book_ref.quote: Nuclei lying in different environments can be flipped by using the radio waves of same frequency

blocks.prompt:
14 ¹²C nuclei have no net magnetic field because:
(¹²C nuclei ka koi khalis magnetic field kyun nahi hota?)

options.text: un ka mass number odd hai
un mein aik akela proton hai
un ke protons apne spins jorr lete hain aur neutrons apne

blocks.explanation: Even atomic aur even mass number wale nuclei mein protons apne spins jorr lete hain aur neutrons apne, is liye khalis magnetic field nahi hota (Book correction).

book_ref.quote: so such nuclei, e.g. ¹²C, have no net magnetic field

blocks.prompt:
15 Which statement about nuclei with even atomic and even mass numbers is correct?
(Even atomic aur even mass number wale nuclei ke baare mein kaun sa bayan durust hai?)

options.text: un mein hamesha protons aur neutrons barabar hote hain
un mein protons aur neutrons even hote hain, hamesha barabar nahi
woh hamesha taqatwar NMR signal dete hain
un mein neutrons odd hote hain

blocks.explanation: Aise nuclei mein protons aur neutrons dono even hote hain magar hamesha barabar nahi, maslan ¹⁸O mein 8 protons aur 10 neutrons hain (Book correction).

book_ref.quote: but not always equal numbers (¹⁸O has 8 protons and 10 neutrons)

blocks.prompt:
16 Ordinary solvents are avoided in ¹H NMR because they:
(¹H NMR mein aam solvents se kyun bacha jata hai?)

options.text: organic compounds ko hal nahi karte
tamam radio waves jazb kar lete hain
un ke hydrogen atoms taqatwar mudakhlat wale signals dete hain

blocks.explanation: Aam solvents mein hydrogen atoms hote hain jo taqatwar signals de kar sample ke spectrum mein mudakhlat (interference) karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Ordinary solvents contain hydrogen atoms which produce strong signals

blocks.prompt:
17 Which of the following is a deuterated solvent used in ¹H NMR?
(In mein se kaun sa deuterated solvent ¹H NMR mein istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: CDCl₃ aur CD₃OD (deuterated methanol) jaise deuterated solvents istemal hote hain.

book_ref.quote: deuterated solvents such as CDCl₃ (deuterated chloroform) or CD₃OD (deuterated methanol)

blocks.prompt:
18 If ordinary CHCl₃ were used as the solvent, the signal of its proton would:
(Agar aam CHCl₃ solvent ke taur par istemal ho to us ke proton ka signal kya karega?)

options.text: sample ke protons ke kamzor signals ko chhupa dega
0.0 ppm par reference ban kar aayega
sample ki har peak ko split kar dega

blocks.explanation: Solvent zyada miqdaar mein hota hai, is liye us ke proton ka signal itna taqatwar hota ke sample ke kamzor signals ko dhaanp leta.

book_ref.quote: the signal from its single proton (¹H) would be intense enough to completely overlap

blocks.prompt:
19 In CDCl₃ the hydrogen atom is replaced by:
(CDCl₃ mein hydrogen atom ki jagah kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: CDCl₃ mein hydrogen ki jagah us ka isotope deuterium (D) hai.

book_ref.quote: In CDCl₃, hydrogen (H) is replaced with its isotope Deuterium (D)

blocks.prompt:
20 A deuterated solvent is described as 'silent' in ¹H NMR because deuterium:
(Deuterated solvent ko ¹H NMR mein 'silent' kyun kaha jata hai?)

options.text: use flip hone ke liye mukhtalif radio frequency chahiye, is liye ¹H peak nahi deta
woh ¹H wali frequency hi zyada taqat se jazb karta hai

blocks.explanation: Deuterium ko flip karne ke liye mukhtalif radio frequency chahiye, is liye woh sample wali frequency jazb nahi karta aur ¹H peak nahi deta.

book_ref.quote: This makes the solvent "silent", and only the signals of the sample are observed

blocks.prompt:
21 Chemical shift represents the position of a signal relative to:
(Chemical shift kis ke muqable mein signal ki jagah batata hai?)

options.text: spectrum ki sab se bari peak

blocks.explanation: Chemical shift kisi reference compound ke muqable mein signal ki jagah batata hai.

book_ref.quote: represents the position of a signal relative to a reference compound

blocks.prompt:
22 The standard reference compound in ¹H NMR is:
(¹H NMR mein standard reference compound kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Tetramethylsilane, Si(CH₃)₄ (TMS), standard reference hai.

book_ref.quote: Tetramethylsilane, Si(CH₃)₄ (commonly known as TMS) is used as the standard reference

blocks.prompt:
23 The signal of TMS is assigned a chemical shift of:
(TMS ke signal ko kitna chemical shift diya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: TMS ke signal ko 0.0 ppm diya jata hai aur baqi sab signals isi zero point se nape jate hain.

book_ref.quote: its signal is assigned a value of 0.0 ppm

blocks.prompt:
24 Chemical shift (δ) is measured in:
(Chemical shift (δ) kis unit mein napa jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: TMS ke muqable mein peak ki jagah chemical shift (δ) hai, jo parts per million (ppm) mein napa jata hai.

book_ref.quote: is called the chemical shift (δ) which is measured in parts per million (ppm) unit

blocks.prompt:
25 How many protons of TMS share the same chemical environment?
(TMS ke kitne protons ka chemical environment aik jaisa hai?)
blocks.explanation: TMS ke tamam 12 protons (chaar CH₃ groups) ka environment aik hai aur woh aik tez (sharp) peak dete hain.

book_ref.quote: because all 12 of its protons have the same chemical environment and produce a single sharp peak

blocks.prompt:
26 The protons of TMS appear at the extreme right of the spectrum because of:
(TMS ke protons spectrum ke bilkul daayen kinare par kyun aate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Silicon ki kam electronegativity ki wajah se TMS ke protons bilkul daayen aate hain aur aksar organic signals se nahi milte.

book_ref.quote: (due to the low electronegativity of silicon)

blocks.prompt:
27 TMS is easy to remove after use because it is:
(TMS istemal ke baad aasani se kyun nikal jata hai?)

options.text: paani mein bohat hal hone wala

blocks.explanation: TMS chemically inert aur volatile (jaldi bukharat banne wala) hai, is liye istemal ke baad aasani se nikal jata hai.

book_ref.quote: TMS is chemically inert and volatile, which makes it easy to remove after use

blocks.prompt:
28 In the ¹H NMR spectrum of methanol, the -CH₃ protons appear at:
(Methanol ke ¹H NMR spectrum mein -CH₃ protons kahan aate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Methanol ke methyl hydrogens 3.35 ppm par aur O-H hydrogen 4.80 ppm par aata hai.

book_ref.quote: the relative position of peak for methyl (-CH₃) hydrogens at 3.35 ppm

blocks.prompt:
29 The O-H proton of methanol appears at a higher δ (4.80 ppm) than the -CH₃ protons because:
(Methanol ka O-H proton -CH₃ protons se zyada δ (4.80 ppm) par kyun aata hai?)

options.text: us ke ird gird electron density zyada hai
woh electronegative oxygen ke saath hai jo us ke ird gird electron density kam karti hai

blocks.explanation: Electronegative atoms ke qareeb protons ke ird gird electron density kam hoti hai aur woh zyada δ par aate hain; O-H proton oxygen ke saath hai.

book_ref.quote: O-H hydrogen of methanol has a chemical shift of 4.80 ppm

blocks.prompt:
30 Chemically equivalent protons in a molecule:
(Molecule mein chemically equivalent protons:)

options.text: aik hi chemical shift dikhate hain
hamesha quartet mein split hote hain

blocks.explanation: Aik jaise chemical environment wale protons chemically equivalent hain aur un ka chemical shift aik hi hota hai.

book_ref.quote: they exhibit the same chemical shift in the ¹H NMR spectra of that molecule

blocks.prompt:
31 Which of the following gives only ONE peak in its ¹H NMR spectrum?
(In mein se kis ka ¹H NMR spectrum sirf AIK peak deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: TMS, methane, ethane, benzene aur propanone ke tamam protons equivalent hain, is liye har aik sirf aik peak deta hai.

book_ref.quote: All the protons in TMS, methane, ethane, benzene and propanone (acetone) are chemically equivalent

blocks.prompt:
32 Propanone (acetone) gives a single ¹H NMR peak because:
(Propanone (acetone) ¹H NMR mein sirf aik peak kyun deta hai?)

options.text: us mein sirf aik hydrogen atom hai
us ke protons D₂O se badal jate hain
us ke tamam protons chemically equivalent hain
us ka C=O group tamam radio waves jazb kar leta hai

blocks.explanation: Propanone ke tamam protons chemically equivalent hain, is liye aik hi absorption peak aati hai.

book_ref.quote: Each of these compounds gives rise to a single absorption peak in its ¹H NMR spectrum

blocks.prompt:
33 How many different proton environments are present in ethanol (C₂H₅OH)?
(Ethanol (C₂H₅OH) mein protons ke kitne mukhtalif environments hain?)
blocks.explanation: Ethanol mein -CH₃, -CH₂- aur O-H ke protons mukhtalif hain: teen environments.

book_ref.quote: a proton on a -CH₃ group is different from the one on -CH₂- and O-H in ethanol

blocks.prompt:
34 Protons surrounded by high electron density, as in alkyl groups, have:
(Zyada electron density mein ghire protons, jaise alkyl groups mein, ka chemical shift:)
blocks.explanation: Zyada electron density (alkyl groups) kam δ deti hai; kam electron density (F, O, N, Cl ke qareeb) zyada δ deti hai.

book_ref.quote: Protons surrounded by high electron density (alkyl groups) have lower chemical shift values

blocks.prompt:
35 Protons that lie near electronegative atoms such as F, O, N or Cl appear at:
(F, O, N ya Cl jaise electronegative atoms ke qareeb protons kahan aate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Electronegative atoms ke qareeb kam electron density wale protons zyada δ par aate hain.

book_ref.quote: (near electronegative atoms like F, O, N, Cl etc.) appear at high chemical shift values

blocks.prompt:
36 The usual chemical shift range of a ¹H NMR spectrum stated in the chapter is:
(Chapter ke mutabiq ¹H NMR spectrum ki chemical shift range kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: ¹H NMR spectrum ki δ range 0 – 12 ppm hai; ¹³C NMR ki 0 – 220 ppm.

book_ref.quote: A ¹H NMR spectrum has a chemical shift (δ) range of 0 – 12 ppm

blocks.prompt:
37 According to Table 30.1, the protons of CH₃–Ar (alkyl next to an aromatic ring) appear in the range:
(Table 30.1 ke mutabiq CH₃–Ar (aromatic ring ke saath alkyl) ke protons kis range mein aate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Table 30.1: aromatic ring ke saath alkyl (CH₃–Ar, –CH₂–Ar, >CH–Ar) 2.3 – 3.0 ppm.

book_ref.quote: Alkyl next to aromatic ring

blocks.prompt:
38 Protons attached directly to an aromatic ring (Ar–H) appear in the range:
(Aromatic ring se seedhe jure protons (Ar–H) kis range mein aate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Table 30.1: aromatic protons Ar–H 6.5 – 9.0 ppm.

book_ref.quote: Aromatic (attached to aromatic ring)

blocks.prompt:
39 Vinylic protons of alkenes (>C=CHR) appear in the range:
(Alkenes ke vinylic protons (>C=CHR) kis range mein aate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Table 30.1: vinylic (alkene) protons 4.5 – 6.0 ppm.

book_ref.quote: Table 30.1 Chemical shifts of some common types of protons

blocks.prompt:
40 A CH₃ group next to a C=O group (as in a ketone or ester) gives a signal in the range:
(Ketone ya ester mein C=O ke saath CH₃ group ka signal kis range mein hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Table 30.1: C=O ke saath alkyl (ketone/ester) 2.0 – 2.6 ppm.

book_ref.quote: CH₃–C=O, –CH₂–C=O, >CH–C=O

blocks.prompt:
41 In which range do the protons of a CH₃–O group appear (Table 30.1)?
(CH₃–O group ke protons kis range mein aate hain (Table 30.1)?)
blocks.explanation: Table 30.1: electronegative atom ke saath alkyl (CH₃–O, –CH₂–O, CH₃–Cl, –CH₂–Cl) 3.0 – 4.5 ppm.

book_ref.quote: CH₃–O, –CH₂–O, CH₃–Cl, –CH₂–Cl

blocks.prompt:
42 A singlet at 11.5 ppm in a ¹H NMR spectrum most likely belongs to the proton of:
(¹H NMR spectrum mein 11.5 ppm par singlet ghaliban kis proton ka hai?)
blocks.explanation: Table 30.1: carboxylic acid RCOOH 9.0 – 13.0 ppm; options mein se 11.5 ppm sirf isi range mein aata hai.

book_ref.quote: Table 30.1 Chemical shifts of some common types of protons

blocks.prompt:
43 The aldehyde proton (RCHO) appears in the range:
(Aldehyde proton (RCHO) kis range mein aata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Table 30.1: aldehyde RCHO 9.0 – 10.0 ppm.

book_ref.quote: Table 30.1 Chemical shifts of some common types of protons

blocks.prompt:
44 According to Table 30.1, the Ar–OH proton of a phenol appears in the range:
(Table 30.1 ke mutabiq phenol ka Ar–OH proton kis range mein aata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Table 30.1: phenol Ar–OH 4.5 – 7.0 ppm.

book_ref.quote: Table 30.1 Chemical shifts of some common types of protons

blocks.prompt:
45 Which type of proton has the widest range in Table 30.1, 5.0 – 12.0 ppm?
(Table 30.1 mein kis qisam ke proton ki range 5.0 – 12.0 ppm hai?)
blocks.explanation: Table 30.1: amide RCONHR 5.0 – 12.0 ppm; alkyl amine 1.0 – 5.0, aryl amine 3.0 – 6.0, aldehyde 9.0 – 10.0 ppm.

book_ref.quote: Table 30.1 Chemical shifts of some common types of protons

blocks.prompt:
46 Protons of an alkane (–CH₃, –CH₂–, >CH–) appear in the range:
(Alkane ke protons (–CH₃, –CH₂–, >CH–) kis range mein aate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Table 30.1: alkyl (alkanes) 0.5 – 1.5 ppm, zyada electron density ki wajah se sab se kam δ.

book_ref.quote: Table 30.1 Chemical shifts of some common types of protons

blocks.prompt:
47 Which of the following is NOT one of the three pieces of information given by a low-resolution ¹H NMR spectrum?
(Low-resolution ¹H NMR spectrum ki teen maloomaat mein se kaun si NAHI hai?)

options.text: protons ke mukhtalif environments ki tadaad
har environment mein protons ki nisbati tadaad

blocks.explanation: Low-resolution spectrum protons ke environments ki tadaad, un ki qisam aur har aik mein protons ki nisbati tadaad batata hai.

book_ref.quote: three main pieces of information about the structure of a compound

blocks.prompt:
48 The number of peaks in a ¹H NMR spectrum corresponds to the number of:
(¹H NMR spectrum mein peaks ki tadaad kis ki tadaad ke barabar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Peaks ki tadaad protons ke mukhtalif environments ke barabar hai, protons ki tadaad ke nahi.

book_ref.quote: corresponds to the number of different chemical environments for protons present in the molecule

blocks.prompt:
49 The chemical shift of a peak tells us the:
(Kisi peak ka chemical shift hamein kya batata hai?)

options.text: protons ke chemical environment ki qisam

blocks.explanation: Har peak ka chemical shift us peak wale protons ke chemical environment ki qisam batata hai.

book_ref.quote: corresponds to the type of chemical environment of protons giving rise to that peak

blocks.prompt:
50 The area under a peak in a ¹H NMR spectrum is proportional to the:
(¹H NMR spectrum mein peak ke neeche ka area kis ke mutanasib hai?)

options.text: saath wale carbon par protons ki tadaad
us peak wale protons ki tadaad

blocks.explanation: Har peak ke neeche ka area us peak wale protons ki tadaad ke mutanasib hai.

book_ref.quote: The area under each peak is proportional to the number of protons giving rise to that peak

blocks.prompt:
51 In the low-resolution ¹H NMR spectrum of ethanol (Figure 30.4), the peak at 3.7 ppm is due to:
(Ethanol ke low-resolution ¹H NMR spectrum (Figure 30.4) mein 3.7 ppm wali peak kis ki hai?)
blocks.explanation: Figure 30.4 mein 5.4 ppm OH, 3.7 ppm oxygen ke saath –CH₂– aur 1.2 ppm –CH₃ hai.

book_ref.quote: The peak having chemical shift 3.7 ppm can be identified as –CH₂– next to oxygen

blocks.prompt:
52 In the ¹H NMR spectrum of ethanol, the signal at 1.2 ppm belongs to the:
(Ethanol ke ¹H NMR spectrum mein 1.2 ppm wala signal kis ka hai?)
blocks.explanation: 1.2 ppm wala signal ethanol ke methyl group (–CH₃ protons) ka hai.

book_ref.quote: while the signal at 1.2 ppm can be identified as methyl group

blocks.prompt:
53 The relative peak areas in the ¹H NMR spectrum of ethanol (OH : CH₂ : CH₃) are:
(Ethanol ke ¹H NMR spectrum mein nisbati peak areas (OH : CH₂ : CH₃) kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Peaks par 1H, 2H aur 3H likha hai: OH, CH₂ aur CH₃ ke areas 1 : 2 : 3.

book_ref.quote: peaks are labeled 1H, 2H and 3H to show relative peak areas in 1:2:3 ratio

blocks.prompt:
54 A compound gives three ¹H NMR peaks with relative areas 3 : 2 : 3 and the simplest whole-number ratio equals the actual numbers. The total number of hydrogen atoms in the molecule is:
(Aik compound teen ¹H NMR peaks deta hai jin ke nisbati areas 3 : 2 : 3 hain aur sab se saada ratio hi asal tadaad hai. Molecule mein kul hydrogen atoms kitne hain?)
blocks.explanation: Har environment ke protons ka majmooa kul tadaad deta hai: 3 + 2 + 3 = 8 hydrogen atoms.

book_ref.quote: Hence, there are total 6 hydrogen (1+2+3) atoms in an ethanol molecule

blocks.prompt:
55 A compound C₂H₄O₂ shows two ¹H NMR peaks with relative areas 2.4 : 0.8. How many protons does each peak represent?
(Compound C₂H₄O₂ do ¹H NMR peaks deta hai jin ke nisbati areas 2.4 : 0.8 hain. Har peak kitne protons ki hai?)
blocks.explanation: 2.4 : 0.8 = 3 : 1; kul 4 H, is liye peaks 3 H aur 1 H ki hain.

book_ref.quote: This ratio matches with the number of protons in each environment

blocks.prompt:
56 A low-resolution ¹H NMR spectrum of a compound shows four peaks. This means the molecule has:
(Kisi compound ka low-resolution ¹H NMR spectrum chaar peaks dikhata hai. Is ka matlab hai molecule mein:)
blocks.explanation: Har peak aik mukhtalif chemical environment hai; chaar peaks yani protons ke chaar environments.

book_ref.quote: The spectrum has three peaks which shows that there are three different proton environments

blocks.text: 30.4.2 High-Resolution 1H NMR and Splitting of Peaks

blocks.prompt:
57 Besides nearby electrons, the NMR signal of a proton is affected by:
(Qareeb ke electrons ke ilawa proton ka NMR signal kis se mutasir hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: NMR signals qareeb ke electrons aur saath wale atoms ke protons se mutasir hote hain; yeh high resolution mein nazar aata hai.

book_ref.quote: but also by protons on the adjacent atoms

blocks.prompt:
58 In a high-resolution ¹H NMR spectrum, a peak is often found to be made up of:
(High-resolution ¹H NMR spectrum mein peak aksar kis se bani hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: High resolution dikhata hai ke har peak aksar sub-peaks ka guchha hai, jo saath wale carbon ke protons ki wajah se hai.

book_ref.quote: it reveals that each peak is often made up of a cluster of sub-peaks

blocks.prompt:
59 According to the n+1 rule, n stands for the number of:
(n+1 rule mein n kis ki tadaad hai?)

options.text: saath wale carbon atom(s) par protons

blocks.explanation: Signal n+1 sub-peaks mein split hota hai, jahan n saath wale carbon atoms par protons ki tadaad hai.

book_ref.quote: A signal usually splits into n+1 sub-peaks, where n is the number of protons on adjacent carbon atoms

blocks.prompt:
60 In the high-resolution spectrum of ethanol, the -CH₃ signal is a:
(Ethanol ke high-resolution spectrum mein -CH₃ signal kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Saath wale carbon par 2 protons hain, is liye 2 + 1 = 3 sub-peaks: triplet.

book_ref.quote: the -CH₃ peak is split into three sub-peaks (known as triplet)

blocks.prompt:
61 The -CH₂- signal of ethanol splits into four sub-peaks because the adjacent carbon carries:
(Ethanol ka -CH₂- signal chaar sub-peaks mein kyun split hota hai? Saath wale carbon par:)
blocks.explanation: Saath wale carbon par 3 protons hain, is liye 3 + 1 = 4 sub-peaks: quartet.

(Compound C₂H₆O ¹³C spectrum mein sirf AIK peak deta hai, 50 – 70 ppm range mein. Compound kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aik peak yani dono carbons equivalent hain aur dono O se jure hain (50 – 70 ppm): CH₃–O–CH₃. Ethanol do peaks deta hai.

book_ref.quote: Use the information from the peak count and positions to draw possible structures

blocks.prompt:
122 The ¹³C spectrum of the C₄H₁₀O compound in Figure 30.8 (69.0, 30.5 and 19.0 ppm) actually fits:
(Figure 30.8 ke C₄H₁₀O compound ka ¹³C spectrum (69.0, 30.5 aur 19.0 ppm) asal mein kis se milta hai?)
blocks.explanation: 2-methoxypropane do C–O carbons deta; 69.0, 30.5 aur 19.0 ppm 2-methylpropan-1-ol se milte hain, jis mein bhi teen carbon environments hain (Book correction).

book_ref.quote: The values 69.0, 30.5 and 19.0 ppm fit 2-methylpropan-1-ol

blocks.prompt:
123 How many isomers does C₄H₁₀O have in all (alcohols and ethers)?
(C₄H₁₀O ke kul kitne isomers (alcohols aur ethers) hain?)
blocks.explanation: C₄H₁₀O ke chaar alcohols aur teen ethers hain: 4 + 3 = 7 isomers (Book correction).

book_ref.quote: C₄H₁₀O also has more than three isomers (four alcohols and three ethers)
